author: Studio Yotta
title: Hiring skilled animation artists
content: Hiring! Looking for skilled animation artists, comfortable working in graphic styles (bold lines/strong shapes) that mix Eastern and Western aesthetics. We're especially interested if you can produce clean, confident & on-model layouts/key poses. Apply @ apply@studioyotta.com

title: Game studio hiring 2D Illustrator
content: A game dev studio is hiring a 2D Illustrator (Remote - Budapest). Create illustrations, environments, characters, and game assets for an upcoming game. This part-time role is approximately 20 hours per week, with a path to full-time, and offers a hybrid work arrangement combining Budapest and remote work. Requires an English CV and portfolio.
